verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a mobile pricing-table layout that displays all pricing information without horizontal scrolling.
The agency recommends horizontal scrolling or a fixed first column instead of the client's no-scroll layout and explicitly requests a decision.
The client accepts the current horizontal-scrolling interaction for the mobile pricing table; replacing the same interaction attribute leaves no obsolete key to remove.
The client's acceptance of the current mobile pricing interaction resolves the pending choice and returns the Requirement to active status.
